The '''D-25 Turbo Disruptor''' was a type of [[Disruptor rifle/Legends|disruptor rifle]] produced during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]].
